title: The Grumpy Badger Who Found a Smile: Joy Is Contagious!

lines.text: Boris the badger woke up on the prickly side of his underground den!
lines.caps: Boris the badger woke *UP | on the prickly side of his underground *DEN!

lines.text: He scowled at the morning sun and grunted at every animal he passed on the trail!
lines.caps: He scowled at the morning *SUN | and grunted at every animal he passed *ON | the *TRAIL!

lines.text: Soon, all the forest birds stopped singing and the chipmunks scurried away into trees!
lines.caps: Soon, all the forest birds stopped *SINGING | and the chipmunks scurried away into *TREES!

lines.text: Being grumpy made the whole forest feel chilly, cloudy, and lonely!
lines.caps: Being grumpy made the whole *FOREST | feel chilly, cloudy, and *LONELY!

lines.text: Then little Pippin the bunny hopped up and beamed a gigantic, warm, goofy smile!
lines.caps: Then little Pippin the bunny hopped *UP | and beamed a gigantic, warm, goofy *SMILE!

lines.text: Boris tried to stay mad, but the cheerful smile tickled his whiskers like warm sunshine!
lines.caps: Boris tried to stay *MAD, | but the cheerful smile tickled his whiskers like warm *SUNSHINE!

lines.text: A tiny chuckle escaped his snout, then grew into a roaring belly laugh!
lines.caps: A tiny chuckle escaped his *SNOUT, | then grew into a roaring *BELLY | *LAUGH!

lines.text: Smiles are like magic boomerangs—the more you give, the more bounce right back!
lines.caps: Smiles are like magic *BOOMERANGS— | the more you give, the more bounce right *BACK!
